LAN rooms

A LAN room makes everyone in it look like one local network, for older games that only find each other by LAN broadcast. A small helper puts the room on a virtual network adapter on this computer, and only the game's own ports are reachable through it.

Connections

How this launcher reaches the mesh. Nothing here is a server you depend on: any relay or neighbour that carries Reticulum will do.

Indexes

An index is somebody else's list of servers, and it is optional. Browsing works without one — the launcher hears servers directly. An index adds the ones it has heard that you have not, which is how you find a server too far away to have reached you yet.
